form: A complete answer must give a single exact real number equal to the infimum of all c in [0,1] for which the stated finite triangle-free homomorphism-target property holds, and justify that it is the infimum. It need not decide whether the property holds at the infimum itself.
not_enough: Bounds that do not identify a unique exact value, an approximation alone, an unknown or undetermined status, a conjecture-dependent value, or results covering only some values of c without establishing the exact infimum would not settle the question.
